title: style(eslint): Add ordering rule on React props
body:
React props and propTypes should now be set in alphabetical order.
This will help in the diffs and overall visual parsing of props.

Fixes #154 

For vim users, you can add `vnoremap s :!sort -V<CR>` to be able to
sort the current visual selection.

comments.body: Great! this should be merged after other PR otherwise previous PR will get conflicts while this one should be the one getting conflicts :D (not so much conflicts)
